title: 第9章 禁魔之地的械斗第10章 真武将军逃了猪八戒人都麻了
slug: 西游反正很无聊随便打个劫呗
lines: “你这毛脸和尚还没死？”
楚云故作惊讶的说道。
“你这强盗，就算是你死了，你孙外公也不会死的！”
孙悟空又开始占着口头便宜。
这种自称对方爷爷外公的事情，他没少干。
楚云一挥手。
“上，打死他！”
现在是禁魔之地，孙悟空无法使用法力。
刚好可以让手下这群小喽啰，练练手。
一群小喽啰。
有的拿着长刀，有的拿着木棍，就冲上去。
仅仅片刻钟。
几十名小喽啰，便被打倒在地。
是的！
楚云的跟班最多只能算是地痞流氓。
孙悟空即使无法使用法力，他那数百年的武学积累，可不是他们这些小喽啰，可以比拟的。
“哎哟，疼死我了！”
无论是小六子，还是二毛子。
都是捂着肚子在地上哀嚎。
“废物！
平日里让你们锻炼锻炼身体，就是不听！”
“现在倒好，别人一招就把你们打倒了！”
楚云缓慢地走向孙悟空。
“你这强盗，上次是俺老孙大意了，意识让你占了上风。”
“这次，让你见识一下俺老孙的厉害！”
即使没有如意金箍棒，孙悟空的武艺也是不弱。
直接飞身跳起，一脚踢向了楚云。
楚云一个侧身抓住孙悟空的脚腕，然后将其丢了出去。
这禁魔之地。
孙悟空无法使用法力，并不代表楚云同样不能。
下一刻！
楚云来到了孙悟空身边，一脚重重的踏在了他腿上。
咔嚓！
一阵骨骼碎裂的声音传来。
嘶！
真武将军倒吸了一口凉气。
孙悟空不是金刚不坏之身吗？
难道这禁魔之地影响到了他的金刚不坏之身？
“俺老孙啊，俺老孙……”
孙悟空还想要说什么？
直接被楚云一脚踢到脑袋上，晕厥了过去。
content_en:
"You hairy-faced monk is not dead yet?"
Chu Yun said pretending to be surprised.
"You robber, even if you die, your grandpa will not die!"
Sun Wukong began to take advantage of words again.
He often does this kind of thing of calling himself grandpa and grandpa.
Chu Yun waved his hand.
"Go on, beat him to death!"
Now it is a forbidden magic place, and Sun Wukong cannot use his magic power.
Just enough to let my group of minions practice their skills.
"Kill!"
A bunch of minions.
Some were holding long knives, and some were holding wooden sticks, and they rushed forward.
Just a moment.
Dozens of minions were knocked to the ground.
Yes!
Chu Yun's followers can only be regarded as ruffians at best.
Even if Sun Wukong cannot use his magic power, his hundreds of years of martial arts accumulation are not something that little guys like them can compare to.
"Ouch, it hurts me so much!"
Whether it's Xiaoliuzi or Ermaozi.
They were all holding their stomachs and wailing on the ground.
"Trash!
I tell you to exercise on weekdays, but you just don’t listen! "
"It's better now, someone else will knock you down with one move!"
Chu Yun slowly walked towards Sun Wukong.
"You robber, I was careless last time, and your consciousness gave you the upper hand."
"This time, let you see how powerful I am!"
Even without the Ruyi Golden Cudgel, Sun Wukong's martial arts is not weak.
He jumped up and kicked Chu Yun.
Chu Yun turned sideways and grabbed Sun Wukong's ankle, then threw him out.
This forbidden place.
Just because Sun Wukong cannot use magic power does not mean that Chu Yun cannot also use it.
The next moment!
Chu Yun came to Sun Wukong and stepped heavily on his leg.
Click!
There was a sound of bones breaking.
hiss!
General Zhenwu took a breath of cold air.
Isn’t Sun Wukong indestructible?
Did this forbidden demon place affect his indestructible body?
"My grandson, my grandson..."
What else does Sun Wukong want to say?
He was kicked directly on the head by Chu Yun and fainted.
